name: Coty
outlook:
What Coty says to expect

  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: like-for-like revenueCoty expects 2Q27 LFL revenue to decline by a low-single-digit percentage, broadly consistent with the last two quarters.
  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: adjusted EBITDA and EPSCoty anticipates Q2 adjusted EBITDA to decline by a high-single-digit percentage, consistent with the trends in Q1. This is expected to result in adjusted EPS, excluding the equity swap, of $0.16 to $0.18 per share.
  • First half fiscal 2027: free cash flowCoty continues to expect free cash flow for the first half of FY27 of over $300 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
